newsitem.title: USA: Fed refrains from open market operations.
newsitem.headline: Fed refrains from open market operations.

text.p: The Federal Reserve refrained from open market operations on Tuesday, dealers said.
A fairly soft Federal funds rate had encouraged analysts to anticipate that the Fed would probably refrain from open market action.
Fed funds were trading at 5-7/16 percent, below the Fed's 5-1/2 percent target for the rate, at the Fed's typical time for intervention.
(( E. Freilich, North American Treasury Desk 212-859-1679))
